_meta.description: Detection patterns for the six AI-generated code failure modes
_meta.author: Md. Sowad Al-Mughni <sowad.al.mughni@gmail.com>

secrets.description: Hardcoded credentials, API keys, and tokens in source code or tracked config files

api_keys.name: Stripe Live Secret
api_keys.context: Payment key in production — immediate breach risk

api_keys.name: Stripe Test Secret
api_keys.context: Test key — should not be in source

api_keys.name: OpenAI API Key
api_keys.context: LLM API key — cost exposure risk

api_keys.name: Anthropic API Key
api_keys.context: LLM API key — cost exposure risk

api_keys.name: Supabase Service Key
api_keys.context: JWT — check if service role key in client bundle

client_bundle_exposure.name: Server key in React/Next component
client_bundle_exposure.context: Server-side env var used in client component — key exposed to browser

client_bundle_exposure.name: Supabase service role in client
client_bundle_exposure.context: Service role bypasses RLS — catastrophic if client-side

rls.description: Row Level Security disabled or missing on tables containing user data
rls.context: 88% of AI-generated Supabase apps had RLS disabled or misconfigured in 2026 security audits

checks.database_query: SELECT schemaname, tablename, rowsecurity FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' ORDER BY tablename
checks.policy_query: SELECT schemaname, tablename, policyname, permissive, roles, cmd FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' ORDER BY tablename

static_patterns.name: RLS never enabled
static_patterns.context: Check paired with ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

static_patterns.name: Anonymous key in backend
static_patterns.context: Anon key should only be in client-side code

auth.description: Missing authentication guards on API routes, or auth checks implemented only in the UI layer

client_side_only.name: UI-only auth check
client_side_only.context: Auth check in UI is bypassable — must also exist in API

client_side_only.name: Conditional render auth
client_side_only.context: Rendering gated by auth state — ensure API also enforces

schema_connectivity.description: Database tables created in migrations but never queried in application code

unwired_integration_signals.name: Placeholder function body
unwired_integration_signals.context: Function stub — check if this is a real integration or unfinished code

unwired_integration_signals.name: Hardcoded mock data
unwired_integration_signals.context: Mock data in production path — should be real API call

n1_queries.description: Query-in-loop patterns that cause O(n) database calls where one batched query would suffice
n1_queries.context: Documented case: single AI-generated admin dashboard caused $12,000/month in database costs from N+1 queries

loop_with_query.name: map with await query
loop_with_query.context: Parallel queries — use findMany or IN clause instead

loop_with_query.name: forEach with await
loop_with_query.context: forEach ignores async — likely causing race conditions too

loop_with_query.name: Promise.all with per-item query
loop_with_query.context: Better than serial but still N queries — use batch

missing_eager_loading.name: Prisma findMany no include
missing_eager_loading.context: Check for missing include: {} for related entities

missing_eager_loading.name: SQLAlchemy no joinedload
missing_eager_loading.context: Check for missing joinedload() for related entities

missing_pagination.name: Unbounded findAll/findMany
missing_pagination.context: No pagination — will return all rows at production scale

missing_pagination.name: SELECT * without LIMIT
missing_pagination.context: Unbounded query — add LIMIT and OFFSET

finops.description: Infrastructure patterns that cause runaway cloud costs at production scale
finops.context: AI-generated code can inflate cloud bills by 400% at production scale. Treat cost patterns as bugs.

accidental_fan_out.name: Multiple awaits in one handler
accidental_fan_out.context: Sequential external calls — consider parallel or queue

accidental_fan_out.name: External API in DB transaction
accidental_fan_out.context: HTTP call inside DB transaction holds connection open

unbounded_storage.name: No file size limit on upload
unbounded_storage.context: Unbounded file upload — add maxSize constraint

unbounded_storage.name: No storage lifecycle/TTL
unbounded_storage.context: Files stored without expiry — add lifecycle policy

unbounded_storage.name: Storing every event/log
unbounded_storage.context: Check for retention policy and archival strategy

runaway_loops.name: No dead letter queue on worker
runaway_loops.context: Failed jobs retry forever — add DLQ

runaway_loops.name: setInterval without cleanup
runaway_loops.context: Check for clearInterval() in cleanup — memory leak risk

missing_caching.name: No cache on expensive query
missing_caching.context: Complex JOIN on GET endpoint — add caching layer

missing_caching.name: No HTTP cache headers
missing_caching.context: Response missing cache headers — hitting DB on every request
